verdict.rationale: Bevy is documented as a plain Rust dependency with a code-first cargo workflow, and a probe notes this workflow needs no editor, so command-line builds are inherent to the product. However, the pack contains no first-party documentation of CI pipelines, headless operation, or per-platform export and packaging. Missing for 10: documented CI or headless build guidance, platform export/packaging steps (web, mobile, desktop bundles), and hands-on corroboration of builds running in CI.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can build and export the project from the command line, headless, in CI — no human clicking an editor

citations.quote: Bevy is just a normal Rust dependency. You can either add it to an existing Rust project or create a new one.
the code-first cargo workflow needs no editor for an agent to drive
